background_story: Imran was a quirky artist known for his surreal installations. One day, he stumbled upon an old fishbowl in a thrift store, which sparked an idea for his next project. He began to collect dozens of fishbowls, filling each one with a miniature world of its own. Inside the bowls, he created intricate scenes of cities, forests, and oceans, complete with tiny figurines and props. As his 'Fishbowl Universe' gained attention, Imran became fascinated with the concept of confinement and perspective. He started to see the world as a series of interconnected fishbowls, each one representing a unique reality. His art studio became a labyrinth of glass containers, with Imran at the center, orchestrating the intricate dance of tiny worlds. The fishbowl had become a metaphor for his own creative universe, where the boundaries between reality and fantasy blurred.
